data.title: When kadence is missing, the SessionStart hook prints an install hint and exits 0 instead of running npx
data.why: A teammate's agent must not fail on command not found, but kadence promises no network: a hook written by init that runs npx would download code on someone else's machine without them choosing it. A hint keeps the session working and leaves the install to the human.
data.rejected: Hook falls back to npx -y kadence prime: silent network fetch on a teammate's machine; Leave the bare kadence prime: the second author's first contact is an error
